title: Count loop
statement: For a finite sequence $z$ of Boolean values, the count loop is the result of applying the counting step $(	ext{length of }z+1)$ times to the encoding of the pair consisting of the empty sequence and $z$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite sequence of Boolean values
caveat: The definition depends on the meanings of the counting step and pair encoding, which are not included among the provided definitions.
